leadText:
Sally (Japanese: サリイ Sally) is a character of the day who appeared in The Lost World of Gothitelle!.

Sally was a young girl who first introduced herself to and after they rode the water taxi she and her ran together. The taxi took travelers to Castelia City. She was friends with a who helped her sell tickets and serve refreshments to the passengers. She explained that their taxi business would end when the Skyarrow Bridge would be finished.
 
The young Sally that Ash met was merely an illusion created by Gothitelle from its memories. The real Sally was actually a woman whom he met earlier at a Poké Mart. Like the group, she also tried to cross the Skyarrow Bridge on her way to a new job, but she became lost in Gothitelle's illusion. She eventually came across Gothitelle and tried to stop it from attacking the group. Everyone was shocked by this, and Sally had to explain everything. 

When the Skyarrow Bridge was built, her father was forced to shut down his water taxi business because it would no longer be needed. Sally invited Gothitelle to come live with them in their new city. When Sally grew up, she left her home and Gothitelle behind to become a doctor. Gothitelle was upset by this and left one day. Sally explained to Gothitelle that while their life was wonderful, they could not keep living in the past. Then, she promised to stop by when she visited the Skyarrow Bridge again. Content with this, Gothitelle mysteriously disappeared after saying goodbye to Sally.
